# What If One Office Made, Ran, and Judged the Laws?

<!-- STEP id="one-office-school" -->
## One Principal, Three Jobs

Imagine a school where one principal writes every rule, gives every punishment, and then hears every appeal against that punishment.

A fee rise, a new uniform rule, a detention: nobody else signs anything.

<!-- STEP id="where-is-the-net" -->
## Nowhere Else to Go

Suppose a student thinks a punishment was unfair. The only person who can hear the appeal is the person who gave the punishment, so the student has nowhere else to go.

Now think of a whole country run this way, with one office making, running and judging every law.
